title: S4 Identity, Revision, Suitability & State Dimensions

entries.name: Identity
entries.definition: Immutable or stable root identifier of the governed container or object.

entries.name: Revision
entries.definition: Controlled change/version sequence such as preliminary, shared milestone, or contractual revision.

entries.name: Suitability / Permitted Use
entries.definition: Declared permitted use or reliance status such as S0, S1, S2, S3, S4, A1, A2, or B1 where applicable.

entries.name: CDE Platform State
entries.definition: Governed storage or information state such as WIP, Shared, Published, Archived or coordination placement.

entries.name: Coordination Issue State
entries.definition: Operational coordination issue lifecycle state, separate from container identity and delivery status.

rule: These dimensions shall not be flattened into a single state system or treated as interchangeable identity tokens.
